A quick local example. A tenant off Clairemont Mesa Boulevard might say, My place gets dusty two days after I wipe everything down. How do I know if I need AC cleaning

Most people call after they notice a pattern, not a single bad day. Clairemont Mesa West homes also see a lot of open windows and doors, plus traffic from I 5 and I 805 drifting into the neighborhood air. That mix can show up in your vents.

Signs that point to AC cleaning

  • Dust collecting quickly on furniture even when you clean often
  • Musty or old house smell when the AC kicks on
  • Uneven airflow between rooms
  • Vent covers that look gray or fuzzy around the edges
  • A return grille that looks like it is wearing a sweater
  • Allergy irritation that seems worse indoors than outdoors
  • You moved in recently and do not know the system history
  • Renovation or drywall work happened nearby

If you are working from home, tell us your quiet hours and your must not disturb rooms. We will plan around calls and nap times.
